# Native report-outfit design

Use the existing report-outfit generator itself. Its only design profiles are `transaction` (A / Transaction Precision), `executive` (B / Executive Clarity) and `editorial` (C / Insight Editorial). Run the original `build.py` art/page/table/chart/template constructors with current reviewed content and model inputs. Merely adopting their colours or applying CSS to a previous report does not satisfy this workflow.

Preserve financial CONTENT, evidence, units, conditional wording and review basis; replace the prior presentation with native generated pages, art, tables and new charts. Domain skills own research, methods, models and supplied analytical content. Design selection cannot approve assumptions or upgrade conditional financials. Native branding remains a design concept/application, never a firm-issued opinion, official approval or partner quality certification.

## Choose the working mode

- **New substantial report:** generate all three actual native profiles as complete reports from the same current input, then obtain independent selection at the highest capable reasoning setting actually available. Compare those three generated reports with one another.
- **Small edit or user-selected native profile:** regenerate the necessary native output and verify affected content/pages. A three-report competition is not required for every edit. Preserve explicit format/template constraints; disclose an incompatible native capability instead of silently substituting another design.
- **Valuation content mapping:** prepare input from the ORIGINAL reviewed valuation HTML and corresponding reviewed result JSON, rather than a previously redesigned HTML or old fixture. The current Samsung adapter is optional and specific to its source/model structure; it is not a generic company or domain analyzer.

Read [workflow](references/workflow.md) for native commands and runtime discovery, [content contract](references/content-contract.md) for `report_sections` and retention/provenance, and [design judgment](references/design-judgment.md) for the sourcebook and independent scoring prompt.

## Execution and evidence

Resolve the actual installed skill root. The native bundle consists of `scripts/build.py`, `prepare_report.py`, `full_report.py`, `html_dom.py`, `render.mjs`, `verify_report.py`, `ledger.py` and the native report-outfit assets/fonts. Discover Python, Node, browser and libraries through environment dependency tools or runtime metadata; use documented overrides, not local hardcoded paths. Check the installed helpers' help and presence; packaging in progress is not an executed build.

Always pass an explicit current `--input`, `--mode report`, the matching `--template` and a fresh `--out`. Do not let the generator fall back to its sample inputs or default output directory. Freeze input/source/model, generated HTML/PDF, actual PDF-page rasters and checks with hashes. Record planned and executed work separately and retain requested/observed reviewer model-effort metadata.

Full reports retain all supplied sections using native full-report block/table-row pagination; the historical eight/four-page specimen limit is not a content limit. Regenerate chart SVGs through native constructors from reviewed values and recorded `result_paths`; do not transplant the old chart SVGs. Verify retained bindings, paragraphs, cells, references and every actual PDF page. Automated checks support visual inspection rather than establish financial truth.

Keep the user's analytical structure, language and requested formats. `fdd` is an existing native template key; generic blocks can carry domain-authored nonvaluation content when the actual full-report implementation supports its labels/units. There is no current `esg` template or ESG analysis capability. Do not treat future generic-block mappings as implemented analysis.

Deliver the selected native report and artifact-bound rationale/review, with execution machinery in supporting materials. Describe instruction-only work, missing helpers or unavailable independent review accurately; claim a generated report or model invocation only after actual execution.
